subject.title: Discord routing: mention > reply-target > default owner (suppress default owner when targeted)

question: Should Discord multi-bot routing suppress the per-channel default owner whenever an explicit bot mention or reply-target signal points at another configured bot?
rationale: The source gap is concrete, but the requested behavior intentionally changes who receives existing channel traffic when a targeted signal is present.

options.title: Adopt targeted precedence
options.body: Implement mention > reply-target > default-owner selection in Discord routing and add suppression tests for targeted cases.

options.title: Require explicit policy
options.body: Preserve current default-owner behavior unless users enable a documented multi-bot suppression setting.

options.title: Wait for narrower PR
options.body: Resolve the open implicit-reply policy PR first, then re-evaluate the remaining cross-bot precedence gap.

recommendation.title: Adopt targeted precedence
recommendation.body: Implement mention > reply-target > default-owner selection in Discord routing and add suppression tests for targeted cases.
